summary: Reproduced for 'all tensors'; the ledger's '-img' sub-claim does not hold. doc/convert.md says '-img / image_dump: Save all tensors as images'. At 0b2dba5ac5aa the parser registers both '-img' and '--image_dump'. A conversion with -img of a 12-tensor model wrote images only for the 7 quantized Linear targets (14 files: each weight plus a .reg image); embed_tokens and the three norm weights got none, and the head's dump crashed the conversion (OSError from PIL's JPEG encoder at exllamav3/util/tensor.py:169; lm_head is 151936 wide, beyond JPEG's 65535 limit). The harness row says expected_behaviour because the script's pre-set rule compared counts (14 >= 12) without accounting for two images per Linear; the outcome is set by hand from the per-tensor list in stdout.
what_ran: repro.py reads doc/convert.md and the converter parser's option strings, then converts a tiny random 1-layer LlamaForCausalLM (Qwen2.5 tokenizer files, vocab 151936) with -img using the repository's convert_model parser/prepare/main on physical GPU 1, and lists the image files written. Environment py311-81fd62ef04f7-torch26cu126 with matplotlib 3.10.1 added (resolved as of 2025-04-29; lazily imported by save_tensor_image).
limits: Conversion did not finish because the head image could not be encoded; any images the converter would write after the head (none expected) are unobserved. The JPEG failure for vocab > 65535 is a separate observation, not this finding.

model.repo_id: synthetic tiny LlamaForCausalLM generated by repro.py (tokenizer from Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct)
